requestedIntent: Stop paying ACEF lifecycle cost for contained low-risk work after direct repeatedly failed its empirical speed/reliability thresholds, while preserving existing direct-run history and closeout compatibility.
limitations: Direct compatibility state remains supported so existing runs can finish without losing history; hand-authoring state can bypass the CLI admission refusal under ACEF's cooperative local trust model.
The treatment recheck reused unchanged baseline/lightweight controls rather than rerunning them concurrently. This is sufficient for rejection under the preregistered design, not for a proof claim.
Native contained work intentionally has no ACEF audit artifact; repository tests, diff review, and ordinary version control remain its evidence.
